agent_tab: Copy Tab Link on an agent chat tab writes its chat's session link (kind session, no turn), not a tab link; a new chat with no session has no link
description: cmux-next object links (Copy Workspace/Pane/Tab Link, agent chat sessions, outside agent sessions), generated from CmuxNextActions/DeepLink (DeepLink.url) and CloudConfiguration.callbackScheme. Do not edit: CMUX_UPDATE_ACTION_SURFACES=1 swift test --filter LinkExportTests rewrites it.
ignored: every other query parameter is ignored, so a link never carries a command

kinds.id_rule: an acpmux session id: 1 to 200 ASCII letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'
kinds.turn: optional fragment #turn-<turnId>; the turn id follows the same rule

kinds.hints: optional ?host=<machine name>&name=<agent name>, for display only: 1 to 64 characters of the session id rule; a malformed hint is dropped
kinds.id_rule: harness: an acpmux harness name, 1 to 64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or '-'; session: the harness's own session id, 1 to 256 ASCII letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', or ':'
kinds.message: optional ?message=<harness message id>, the session's own id for one message (1 to 200 ASCII letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'): the chat scrolls to it and marks it, and leaves the view where it is when its transcript has no such message. A malformed or repeated one is dropped, never the link
kinds.opens: only a tab this app already shows the session in (the chat tab that adopted it, else the terminal running it); it never starts, resumes or connects to anything
kinds.schema: schemas/deeplinks/agent-link.json states these parameters and their vectors for every emitter and parser (cmux.com/deeplink/agent writes links by it)

machine: optional ?machine=machine_<32 hex>: the machine the target lives on (a hint; ids are globally unique)
not_links: cmux://auth-callback is the sign-in callback, never a link

schemes.rule: cmux-dev-<tag>, the tag lowercased, runs of [a-z0-9] joined by single hyphens

target_scheme_rule: A client that is not a shipping cmux build writes the release scheme, so the link opens the user's installed cmux.
